title: Ollama runner options
description: The run/start options the Ollama runner takes. Only model is required. They fill the runner contract's runnerOptions extension point. Nothing here names a program to run, and nothing is read from the environment instead.

model.description: The Ollama model to run, as Ollama names it, such as qwen3:4b. It must be pulled, and able to call tools.

endpoint.description: Where Ollama listens: an http or https URL with a host and an optional port, and no user name, password, path, query or fragment. Absent: http://127.0.0.1:11434. Any host is accepted, so a run sends the workspace's contents to wherever this points.

maxTurns.description: The requests one run may make. Reaching it ends the run with an error result. Absent: 50.

contextLength.description: The context window, in tokens, sent as Ollama's num_ctx. At most the model's own maximum. Absent: 16384, or the model's maximum if that's smaller. A run whose conversation outgrows it ends with an error result.

temperature.description: The sampling temperature, sent as Ollama's options.temperature. Absent: Ollama's own.

seed.description: The sampling seed, sent as Ollama's options.seed. Absent: Ollama's own.

think.description: Whether a thinking model thinks, sent as Ollama's think: true, false, or low, medium or high for a model that takes a level. Absent: Ollama's own. The thinking is kept in the transcript only.
